description: Angular component for configuring a progress bar widget in the Thingsboard UI, including form setup, validation, and configuration handling.

classes.name: ProgressBarBasicConfigComponent
classes.description: Angular component for configuring a progress bar widget, extending BasicWidgetConfigComponent, managing form state, validation, and output configuration.

methods.name: displayTimewindowConfig
methods.description: Getter that determines if the timewindow configuration should be displayed based on datasources.

methods.name: onlyHistoryTimewindow
methods.description: Checks if only comparison aggregation datasources are used, indicating a history timewindow.

methods.name: configForm
methods.description: Returns the form group used for widget configuration.

methods.name: defaultDataKeys
methods.description: Provides default data keys, e.g., humidity, for the widget.

methods.name: onConfigSet
methods.description: Initializes the form with configuration data, setting default values and form controls.

methods.name: prepareOutputConfig
methods.description: Prepares and returns the widget configuration data based on form inputs.

methods.name: validatorTriggers
methods.description: Returns list of form control names that trigger validation updates.

methods.name: updateValidators
methods.description: Enables or disables form controls based on current form state to ensure valid configuration.

methods.name: getCardButtons
methods.description: Determines which card buttons (e.g., fullscreen) are enabled based on widget config.

methods.name: setCardButtons
methods.description: Sets widget config options based on selected card buttons.

methods.name: _valuePreviewFn
methods.description: Generates a preview string of the widget's value with units and formatting.
